summary: Backend-only regression for the 'Admin -> Client project tracking assignment' fix on production https://cinemaries.fr. Created /app/backend/tests/test_project_tracking_assignment.py with 8 tests covering the 5 scenarios A-E from the review request. ALL 8 PASS (6.04s). Verified: (A) GET /api/projects/me with test@wedding.fr's token returns project.client_id='hanifa-et-dali', wedding_name mentions Hanifa & Dali, and 9 tracking steps — the direct users.client_id lookup added to project_tracking.py works and no longer requires a wedding_claims doc. (B) GET /api/guestbook/mine returns client_id='hanifa-et-dali' with items array and count>=3. (C) Admin can GET /api/admin/projects (list contains 'hanifa-et-dali') and GET /api/admin/projects/hanifa-et-dali (returns 9 steps). (D) A freshly-registered orphan user (no client_id, no claim) receives 200 with {'project': null} — no crash. (E) Admin without claim receives a project payload with admin_preview=True. No backend changes made; the fix in /app/backend/project_tracking.py:369 (client_id/claimed_client_id first, wedding_claims fallback) behaves correctly on prod.
action_items: Frontend profile.tsx additions ('Mon espace' + 'Livre d'or' shortcuts) were NOT tested here (backend-only run per review_request). Main agent should self-verify on Expo web preview or request a frontend testing pass.
Consider adding periodic cleanup for the ephemeral orphan-*@wedding-test.fr users the test creates (one per pytest run) to avoid slow accumulation in prod DB.
critical_code_review_comments: project_tracking.py:369 correctly prefers current.get('client_id') then claimed_client_id then wedding_claims — good defence in depth.

get_my_project's admin_preview path (line 379-383) returns the FIRST project by natural insertion order; if an admin is later assigned a client_id, they'd bypass admin_preview and see only their own project. Behaviour is consistent with the review_request; documented for future reference.
TestProjectsMeNullForUnclaimed relies on /api/auth/register being open. On prod it currently works; if registration gates are added (invite code, captcha) the test will skip — acceptable.
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral prod user orphan-<uuid8>@wedding-test.fr / Orphan1234! is created per run to validate the 'no client_id -> project=null' contract. No cleanup performed (no delete-my-account endpoint exercised).

The fix under test is in /app/backend/project_tracking.py get_my_project (line ~358): direct users.client_id / claimed_client_id lookup precedes the wedding_claims fallback. Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_project_tracking_assignment.py (8 tests, ~6s). Frontend changes in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (wedding + guestbook shortcuts) still need UI validation.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: /api/projects/me only queried the wedding_claims collection, so a user assigned to a wedding by the admin via users.client_id (without a claim record) got project=null. Fix reads current.get('client_id') or current.get('claimed_client_id') first, falls back to wedding_claims. Verified end-to-end on prod: test@wedding.fr now gets the hanifa-et-dali project with all 9 tracking steps.
